failure_modes.name: Seal degradation
failure_modes.symptoms: Water/dust ingress into actuator; condensation on encoder; corrosion at terminals; loss of IP rating
failure_modes.mitigation: Scheduled seal replacement; material upgrade to fluorocarbon; ingress inspection at service interval

failure_modes.name: Knee overload
failure_modes.symptoms: Excessive current draw on stairs/ascent; gear whine; position lag; thermal trip under sustained load
failure_modes.mitigation: Load-aware gait planning; current limiting; reinforced reducer; dynamic payload capping

failure_modes.name: Lidar contamination
failure_modes.symptoms: Sparse point cloud; phantom returns from mud/water film; degraded SLAM localization; blind spots
failure_modes.mitigation: Wiper/air-blast window cleaning; hydrophobic coating; periodic optical inspection; degraded-mode nav fallback

failure_modes.name: Contactor failure
failure_modes.symptoms: Failure to energize drive bus; welded/stuck contact; no power-on; random bus dropouts
failure_modes.mitigation: Redundant pre-charge circuit; contactor cycle-count monitoring; derating; predictive replacement

failure_modes.name: Resonance
failure_modes.symptoms: Oscillation at gait cadence; amplified vibration at natural frequency; premature fastener loosening
failure_modes.mitigation: Notch filtering; stiffness/tuning sweep at commissioning; damped mounts; gait frequency avoidance band
